title: Carsten Hövekamp - Wikipedia
content: Carsten Hövekamp (* 25. Juli 1982 in Dülmen) ist ein deutscher Politiker (CDU) und seit 2020 Bürgermeister der Stadt Dülmen.

title: Company with family spirit - VEKA
content: From Sendenhorst to the whole world - with our 54locations on 4continents including our 23production plants, we are represented worldwide and sell our products internationally. As a family-run company in the second generation, our roots are in Sendenhorst (Münsterland) in Westphalia. Independent subsidiaries on 4continents complete our international presence and provide jobs for around 7,000employees worldwide. With an annual turnover of over 1.5 billion €, of which 80 % is generated abroad on 4continents, the VEKA Group is officially the world market leader in the field of PVC profile systems for windows and doors. With subsidiaries in Europe, Asia, North and South America, we are represented worldwide and provide jobs for around 7,000employees *(data as of December 2024)*. For more than 50 years we have been producing profile systems for windows, doors, roller shutters as well as sliding doors made of PVC. More than 50 years of VEKA.
